reasoning: Elucidarius Major (1617) is an obscure German alchemical commentary on the Chemical Wedding by Christoph Barbarossa (pseudonym Radtichs Brotofferr). PRDL, OpenEdition academic journal, alchemywebsite.com, Google Books, and targeted web searches all confirm only German/Latin editions exist. The only related Chymical Wedding commentary translated to English (Practica Leonis Viridis 2015) is a different 1619 anonymous work.
